M7.description: DGSI with evolution followed by three-candidate selection

observed_contrasts.interpretation: Small descriptive score increase; no paired-accept gain. Not an isolated evolution effect because M4 does not share the strengthened scope/evidence policy.
Best observed arm; descriptive only. Not an isolated selection effect because M4 does not share the strengthened scope/evidence policy.
Combined recipe underperformed original DGSI in this run.
Adding selection to the evolve-only arm was associated with lower score and one fewer paired accept in this run.
Adding evolution to the select-only arm was associated with lower score and two fewer paired accepts in this run.
Select-only ranked above evolve-only descriptively; candidate count, prompt structure and stochastic generation differ, so this is not a clean component effect.

selector_diagnostic.explanation: All M6 and M7 cases selected I1 under the deterministic tie rule. The run does not demonstrate that selecting a later candidate improved quality.

design_gaps: No same-policy no-evolution/no-selection control arm: M4 is the original DGSI policy, while M5/M6/M7 share strengthened scope/evidence policy.
M5/M6/M7 are useful recipe ablations but not a fully identified 2x2 factorial experiment.
Four cases and two connected source-document clusters are insufficient for population or significance claims.
Exact token usage and equal actual compute were not observed.
GPT review is advisory, not independent human expert clearance.

arms: DGSI strengthened policy, no evolution/no selection
next_valid_experiment.controls: Same frozen input bytes, same candidate budget where technically possible, same generation model family and independent blinded judges; record actual token/cost telemetry if available.
next_valid_experiment.holdout_rule: Use new source-document clusters untouched by this development run. Do not retune on the four cases in this bundle.
next_valid_experiment.stopping_rule: One preregistered run; report all outputs and failures; stop regardless of ranking.
